description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Balance Sheet as at 31st May, 2019 --Reserved on 2016.06.29
categorisation: This gazette content presents the balance sheet of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, which falls under commercial/banking matters. It contains detailed financial data including assets, liabilities, foreign currency holdings, securities, and banking operations. The content focuses on financial institution reporting and accounting matters rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories like land, legal, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
